table.name: _statement
table.definition: executed for effect as an element of a sequence

table.name: _declaration
table.definition: introduces a named entity — function, class or type, variable, interface — with or without a body

table.name: _name
table.definition: denotes or refers to a name: identifier, qualified name, path

table.name: _literal
table.definition: value fully determined by its own text, for every instance of the rule

table.name: _argument
table.definition: actual argument position in an invocation

table.name: _modifier
table.definition: keyword-ish marker altering a declaration's meaning

table.name: _directive
table.definition: affects the compilation unit or its environment rather than computing in it

table.name: _body
table.definition: the body position of a definition or control construct

table.name: _access
table.definition: reads a place: member or index

facets.name: _clause
facets.definition: subordinate piece of a larger construct that is not naturally a statement or expression (else/except/finally/case/where clauses, match arms). FACET TIER: a clause is type-level, not position-level — every construct admits only its own clauses, so a shared _clause supertype would make `if a: ... except E:` parse. Measured in python, rust and typescript alike; see vocabulary 0.2.0 notes.
